structural_breaks.note: Tesar Gulf Power Transformers LLC (Al Ain, UAE) acquired Oct-2023.
SERW spol. s r.o. (Czech HV switches) sold 5-Dec-2023 (2023 sales 15.6m, 2022 10.8m CHF); reported H1/FY2023 still include it (adjusted figures in reports).

De-SPAC: VT5 Acquisition Company acquired R&S International Holding and was renamed R&S Group Holding AG; trading on SIX from 13-Dec-2023. Pre-listing history before H1-2023 is only available as FY2022 (155.1m) in AR2023 — no half-year split.
Kyte Powertech (Cavan, Ireland; oil distribution transformers up to 10 MVA, UK/IE utilities) consolidated from 20-Aug-2024; H2-2024 includes ~4.3 months.
Non-core electrical switches & connectors business of Rauscher & Stoecklin sold Dec-2025 (2025 sales 7.3m, 2024 9.4m CHF); H1-2026 comparisons adjusted by the company (201.4 vs reported 206.3).

profile.products: Pure-play transformers: oil-immersed distribution transformers (Rauscher & Stoecklin, Sissach CH: up to 3.15 MVA / 36 kV; Krzeczów/Bochnia PL plant up to 6.0 MVA / 36 kV; Kyte Powertech IE: single-phase pole-mount 15–100 kVA, 3-phase up to 10 MVA; large distribution 1,600 kVA–10 MVA), oil-immersed power transformers up to 125 MVA / 170 kV (ZREW, Łódź; expanding to 160 MVA / 220 kV with the new Łódź plant from end-2026), cast-resin dry-type and instrument transformers (Tesar, Italy; Tesar Polska), Middle-East units (Tesar Gulf, UAE). Backlog CHF 357.9m at 30-Jun-2026, 61% power transformers.

plants.products: oil distribution transformers up to 3.15 MVA / 36 kV (Rauscher & Stoecklin)
oil distribution transformers 250 kVA–6.0 MVA / 36 kV (new 10,000 m² plant)

profile.end_markets: European distribution utilities (CH, UK, IE, DE, PL, IT), renewables (wind/solar/BESS grid connection), data centers, industry, rail, harbor electrification, Middle East. H1-2026 gross sales: Europe 165.0 of 181.2 CHF m; America 0.2m (UL certification for the US in progress).
